articles.title: Earth's New Mini-Moon Is Staying for Christmas
articles.summary: A tiny space rock called 2026 QQ8 is orbiting Earth until early 2027, when it will drift away again.

articles.title: Scientists Confirm a Third Type of Magnetism
articles.summary: Researchers found strong proof of altermagnetism, a third kind of magnetism that mixes traits of the two known kinds.

articles.title: Would a Bigger Heart Really Make the Grinch Strong?
articles.summary: The Grinch's heart grows three sizes in a day, but real hearts grow slowly, except in pythons, whose hearts can swell after a big meal.
